criteria.evidence: lib/faults.ts treatmentErrorStateAdvice/faultErrorStateAdvice put the fault's remediation on ErrorState and are spread at every ErrorState whose words come from a classified fault or that has the fault object at its render site (run-related, run-logs, run-detail, checkpoints-tab, timeline-tab, schedule-detail/edit, new-schedule, hook-list/deliveries, goal-list, audit, checks-list, run-list, workers-states, view-frame and the others in the diff), plus app/fault-error-state.svelte under the fault boundary and the three query-fault-banner components. faults.test.ts 'the fault-to-view mapping' asserts the remediation for one fault of each of the seven treatment kinds. Not covered, with no fault object at the site: boot-failure, route-outlet, home activity cards, models-section catalog failure, the stopped and canceled states, the refresh-failed Banners.

canRetryFault/treatmentErrorStateAdvice give onRetry only when retryable is not false. faults.test.ts: Retry present for retryable true, for a fault with no field, and for a non-wire error; absent for retryable false across every HttpClientError kind. fault-boundary.test.ts, the three query-fault-banner tests and schedules/fault-banner.test.ts assert the button; run-list-sentences.test.ts and faults.test.ts cover screens that read several things (Retry stays while any failed read can be retried).

fault-boundary.svelte draws app/fault-error-state.svelte, a Cinder ErrorState row, with the same remediation and Retry rule. Cinder first: ErrorState gained a warning tone (warning tokens, role=status) and an announce option (components/cinder error-state: css, types, svelte, test, README, examples.json, a11y note), so conflict and unreachable are warning again, not-found and not-supported neutral, the rest danger, and every kind is announced as an alert with announce; the extra role=alert wrapper is gone. fault-boundary.test.ts asserts tone and role for each kind including the restored conflict warning, with new assertions for remediation under the description and Retry present, absent and defaulted. Deleted from foundation.css, workflows.css and reviews.css: the banner, icon and message rules. Kept: the box (border, tone background) because the ErrorState row draws none, and the note, field-error and stack rules. Changed assertions: tones are read from data-cinder-tone on the ErrorState and the role from its body, not data-tone on the alert. Danger-kind notes sit under the alert region, not inside it.

Remediation is rendered only through ErrorState's remediation prop, a paragraph after the description; no site passes it as title. fault-boundary.test.ts asserts the title is the treatment title and does not contain the remediation, and the line follows the description in document order.
